focus: Adaptive Hierarchical Depth Selection via Capability Composition
question: Can we, using the existing observational dataset, perform a full FZG analysis to estimate G_A for each depth‑horizon pairing and thereby validate whether an adaptive depth‑selection policy would theoretically reduce cumulative planning error compared to any fixed depth?
hypothesis: An adaptive policy that selects hierarchical indexing depth as a function of the planning horizon will exhibit a lower expected cumulative planning error than any static depth, as evidenced by higher G_A values for the adaptive selections derived from the observational data.
next_action: Conduct the FZG analysis on the existing depth‑sweep data to compute G_A estimates and evaluate the adaptive depth‑selection hypothesis.
